name: SIGHT programme: Component II, green hydrogen production incentive
summary: Production incentive, up to ₹4 per kg in year one
outlay: ₹13,050 crore for Component II, to FY 2029–30 (SIGHT total ₹17,490 crore)
howToApply: Bid when SECI issues a Request for Selection (RfS) on its e-tender portal
purpose: Component II pays a fixed incentive per kilogram to companies that produce green hydrogen, or derivatives such as green ammonia and methanol, in their first years of production. Sample text from the design (416:1354).

eligibility.condition: A company registered in India, bidding alone or as a consortium
Builds and operates a new plant in India; contract manufacturing is not allowed
Meets the net worth and bid security set in each RfS

benefits: Mode 1: an incentive per kilogram for three years, set by your bid and capped at:

timeline.what: Mode 1 Tranche I: 4,12,000 t/yr awarded to 10 companies
Mode 2A Tranche I: 7,24,000 t/yr of green ammonia across 13 auctions
Next Mode 1 round: not yet announced

documentsNeeded.document: Certificate of incorporation and board resolution
Net worth certificate from a chartered accountant

faqs.question: Can a start-up bid?
faqs.answer: Only if it meets the net worth and bid security in the RfS, alone or through a consortium. Sample answer.

faqs.question: When is the next round?
faqs.answer: SECI announces each round with a new RfS. Sample answer.
